services.name: Skydive Kentucky
services.desc: On August 22, 2026, brave individuals will take the plunge from 12,000 feet, all in support of United Way of Central Kentucky. Before the event, all participants commit to raise $1,500 or more each, using a provided fundraising pledge website so your friends, family and co-workers can get in on the action! All funds support United Way of Central Kentucky’s Operation Good Neighbor program, aimed at maintaining and keeping at-risk neighbors in their homes. The sky is the limit, raise as much as you can in support of our mission to connect our community for the common good.
